sample_unit: patients with intracranial hemorrhage (289 Pre-AI, 298 Post-AI)
models_evaluated: commercial AI computer-aided triage and prioritization solution for intracranial hemorrhage on head CT (unnamed)

links.outcome: 30- and 120-day all-cause mortality and discharge mRS before vs after AI triage implementation
links.effect: 30-day mortality 27.7% vs 17.5% (p=0.004); 120-day mortality 31.8% vs 21.7% (p=0.017); mRS at discharge 3.2 vs 2.8 (p=0.044), Pre-AI vs Post-AI.
links.quote: The 30- and 120-day all-cause mortality weresignificantly reduced in the Post-AI group when compared to the Pre-AI group (27.7% vs 17.5%; p =0.004 and 31.8% vs 21.7%; p =0.017 respectively).

screen.reason: Evaluates the clinical outcome impact (mortality and morbidity) before vs after real deployment of an AI triage/detection tool for intracranial hemorrhage in an emergency department, but does not compare specific deployment practices/guardrails.
